results.content:
## The best DeskMinder alternatives for Mac

### Gestimer 2: the classic drag-to-remind app

Gestimer 2 has been around since 2015 and popularized the drag gesture DeskMinder also uses: drag down from the menu bar icon, and the further you drag, the longer the timer. Add a title, let go, and you are done. It shows a countdown in the menu bar, handles multiple timers, and syncs with Apple Reminders. [...] Pick DeskMinder if you keep missing short reminders. Pick Gestimer if you want the same speed with quieter alerts, FloatyDo if you need your list in view, Blitzit if you want to plan and time your whole day, Balance if you want structured focus and breaks, and LookAway if your eyes and posture are the real problem. For more focus and productivity tools, browse Mac software on Macfolio.

### More blogs [...] The difference is the alert. Gestimer uses standard, unobtrusive notifications, while DeskMinder is built to grab you. One DeskMinder user on the official site says they switched from Gestimer because DeskMinder "does so much more." If you want quieter reminders and no widget on your desktop, Gestimer is the cleaner choice. It costs $6.99 on the Mac App Store, and there is a free trial on the developer's website.

Stay on top of your tasks with easy-to-create desktop pop-ups. Instead of digging through complex calendars, just click once to set a quick reminder - ideal for urgent to-dos, short breaks, or fleeting ideas.
KEY FEATURES
• Full-Screen Notifications: Perfect for those with ADHD or anyone who needs an extra nudge.
• Apple Reminders Sync: Get your notifications on iPhone, iPad, or Apple Watch via Apple Reminders integration.
• Additional Quick Shortcuts: New shortcuts are now available for creating quick reminders for 5, 10, 15, and 25 minutes.
